#379 implement.summary:
#379 is fixed in one commit, a46092fd, on branch /tmp/wt-379, parent 8f7d98aa (main is still 8f7d98aa). Not pushed.

What changed: a stored OAuth refresh (openai-codex, anthropic, github-copilot) whose token endpoint answered 429 or 5xx, or could not be reached, is now retried by the turn's auto-retry, as pi retries it. It uses the same budget (3), backoff (2/4/8 s), counter and auto_retry_enabled as a provider 502. Each retry refreshes again, and nothing is sent until a refresh succeeds - never an env or models.json key. A refused refresh (400/401/403) and every other StoredCredentialError still fail at once with byte-identical messages.

How it works:
- Classification walks the exception's __cause__ chain, not the message text (oauth/_helpers.refresh_retry_reason).
- The Codex refresh, Anthropic _post_json and Copilot _http_error raise sites now attach the status as data on a plain RuntimeError (oauth_http_error).
- The reason travels OAuthRefreshError.retry_reason -> ResolvedRequestAuth.retry_reason -> the CLI callback's _RequestAuthError.
- The harness's _make_stream_fn turns a raise that carries retry_reason into an error assistant message, like pi's lazyStream. _is_retryable_error retries it by type (_RetryableSetupErrorText); its classifier text is aelix's own sentence, so the token server's body cannot trigger overflow compaction.

Docs: ADR-0251 amended (status line, sections 2.2/3/4/6/7, new section 12), the decisions README row, the providers-and-models and models-json guides plus bundled copies, CHANGELOG Fixed, docstrings, and a stale comment in _high_level.py (same line count). 161 citations moved: 150 by --fix, 11 ambiguous ones by hand from a difflib map; the lock changes only anchors into harness/core.py, cli/entry.py and auth_storage.py, plus 2 anchors whose own cited text holds a moved entry.py number.

owner_decisions: Every 5xx (500-599) counts as transient; pi's pattern lists only 500, 502-504, 520 and 524. 408 is not transient here, and pi does not match it either.

A proxy that refuses the CONNECT (httpx.ProxyError) is retried whatever its status, including 403/407, following pi's 'fetch failed'. A deterministic proxy refusal therefore costs about 14 s before failing.
Classification uses the exception chain rather than pi's text match. As a result an extension refresh raising a bare RuntimeError('502 ...') is not retried, where pi would retry it.
The retried message drops the 'get_api_key_and_headers failed:' prefix (pi's shape), while a refused refresh keeps it (today's text). The two paths now read slightly differently.
The retried message still ends with 'Run /login to sign in to <provider> again.' even for a transient 502 - kept so the text stays the same everywhere.
--mode json exits 0 when every refresh retry fails, as it does for a model's exhausted 502; before this change the raise made it exit 1. Text -p still exits 1.
follow_ups: [\harness] settings.json retry.enabled / retry.maxRetries / baseDelayMs are not read by the harness for any retry: it uses module constants plus the rpc set_auto_retry toggle (_AUTO_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS, _AUTO_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS in harness/core.py). pi reads settings.retry. Every retry, the #379 refresh retry included, ignores the user's setting.

[compaction] the compaction summary, split-turn prefix summary and branch summary call get_api_key_and_headers directly, so a transient OAuth refresh failure (or a provider 502) fails the compaction with no retry. pi's durable compaction retries with isRetryableAssistantError. Consider routing them through the same retry.

[oauth] a dropped connection reads 'Server disconnected without sending a response.. Run /login' (double period): OAuthRefreshError appends '.' after a cause that already ends with one. Pre-existing cosmetic issue.
[json] --mode json exits 0 when the final assistant message is an error, for any provider error after retries. Decide whether json mode should exit 1 like text -p.
[live] not measured live: a real delegated child whose refresh hits a 502 (needs a fake model that emits an agent tool call). It shares the CLI path covered by the json, rpc and TUI runs.

blocking.title: A retry the new path opens is never closed when the next refresh is refused: no auto_retry_end, the counter leaks into the next turn, and the TUI keeps a stale retry widget
blocking.detail: Sequence: the token endpoint answers 5xx, 429 or drops, so the turn retries (auto_retry_start 1/3). The retry's refresh is then refused (400/401/403). _make_stream_fn raises AgentHarnessError('auth') from inside the retry loop of prompt() (harness/core.py ~1528, result = await self._run([], ...)). The raise skips the #147 arm at ~1545-1590, which emits AutoRetryEndEvent(success=False) and resets _retry_attempt, and the finally block resets neither. This is the #147 defect class, and the comment there names this exact sequence. It is realistic here: refresh tokens rotate, so a refresh whose answer was lost (a dropped connection or a proxy 502) leaves the retry holding a consumed token, and that retry gets invalid_grant. pi closes the sequence: lazyStream turns every setup failure, the 401 included, into an error message, and agent-session.ts:1873-1881 emits auto_retry_end(false) and resets _retryAttempt. This falsifies ADR-0251 section 12.2 item 4 and the commit message's 'every mode shows what it shows for that one'. The sweep does not list the path. Fix: when _retry_attempt > 0, close the sequence on a raise from the re-run (emit end(false, final_error=str(exc)), reset, re-raise). Or, during a retry, turn a non-transient callback raise into a non-retryable error message. Add a row: 502 then 401 asserts one start, one end(False,1), counter 0.
blocking.evidence: .omc/probes/379-live/verify/logs/rpc_502_401_then_502_200.out: rpc turn 1 plan 502,401 gives auto_retry_start=[(1,3,2000)] auto_retry_end=[]. Turn 2 plan 502,200 gives auto_retry_start=[(2,3,4000)], so the budget is cut to 2 retries. logs/live_after_refused_json.out: codex 502,401 and anthropic 503,400 give one start and no end. logs/tui_502_401_then_esc.out: after the 401 the TUI keeps 'Retrying (1/3) now... Esc to interrupt', and the next turn shows 'Retrying (2/3) in 3s' and 'Retry succeeded (attempt 2)'. logs/tui_502_401_then_hang_esc.out: the stale widget carries into the next turn, and Esc there prints a spurious 'Retry failed: cancelled'. logs/unit_retry_end_probe.out (probe/unit/test_v379_retry_end.py): the control (a provider 502, then a non-retryable error message) emits end(False,1) with the counter at 0 and passes. The #379 path fails: ends=[].
